name: atm_keypad
text: Stand relaxed in front of the ATM. Reach the RIGHT hand forward and slightly upward onto the real keypad, press several keys with short fingertip taps, withdraw that same hand and lower it beside the right thigh. Keep the LEFT arm hanging relaxed beside the left thigh throughout. Finish fully upright with both arms relaxed down. Feet stay planted.
